COPENHAGEN, Denmark, Jan. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- On 7 January 2026, Freudenberg Home and Cleaning Solutions GmbH (“Freudenberg”) announced a recommended public offer to the shareholders of Nilfisk Holding A/S (“Nilfisk” or the “Company”) to tender all outstanding shares in Nilfisk to Freudenberg at a price of DKK 140 for each share of nominally DKK 20 (the “Offer” and “Offer Price”, respectively), valuing the entire share capital of Nilfisk at approx.
